steps.content: You eliminate all the Corruptors and end up with only 14 "humans" left, all of whom are shaken to the core.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, are you okay?
You feel dizzy after facing off the Corruptors on the operating table. Your ears ring while conflicting emotions scream in your head, then you finally throw up.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Please don't use the shackles on Mania that are going manic next time. The mental burden is way too much for you.
Did your shackles react? Like to the Sinners?
It's Iron. She looks down at you, but you can't read her emotions.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: They are different, but I can't put my finger on the differences.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...I see.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Tell Anne that the operation has failed. The shackles only work on Sinners. We need to find a new treatment plan.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Let me clear my head for a bit and get ready for the next operation.
She approaches you and raises her mechanical arm. But this time, she simply wipes the bile off the corner of your mouth with a warm wet towel.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: You too, ${PlayerName}, get some rest. I was wrong. Mania can hurt you too.
Her voice sounds stiff but non-hostile. Perhaps you are no longer enemies after going through a failed operation together.
But you have many questions for her.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...I see. So she is the reason why SALVA got attacked.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I don't care where she's from or if she's a Sinner. It's our duty to take in and treat a person covered in wounds, lying in front of the gate of SALVA.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: You can investigate or arrest her. I owe you one, but it will have to be after she wakes up.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I won't allow anyone to hinder our treatment.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: What else? There must be more reasons for you to treat us as enemies, right?
She turns to you with a cold sneer.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: What did that man tell you?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You brainwash and control the gangsters.
SALVA collects Corruptors to use Mania...

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: And what else?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Heh... It's always the same stuff.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Heh... No need to keep quiet. It's always the same stuff.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: And what else?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Heh... It's always the same stuff.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Heh... No need to keep quiet. It's always the same stuff.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Let me tell you. This Mania has nothing to do with Sinners. Until today, no one knows exactly where Mania comes from.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: It has been spreading in Syndicate since many years ago.
She puts a vial containing <color=#fb9259>red liquid</color> into your hand, which looks very similar to the red liquid that triggered 728's mutation.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Mania crystal</color>. Liquid. Unknown composition. It triggers Mania and accelerates mutation once injected into the human body.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: This is highly sought after in the gangs. They even fought each other for this.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>power</color> that the Mania mutation brings is what the gangs crave most.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Is it the same this time, right?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: They thought that Sinner escaped from the Bureau had some "inheritance" to control Mania, so they came to SALVA just like annoying, stinky files.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What about you? What do you think of this power?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Me? I'm a doctor, not a gangster. I'm not interested in power.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...All I want is for Mania to disappear.
There is a fire in her silver pupils, which makes you quiver.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I save a dozen lives a day in this dump, give them new arms and legs and strength to stand up straight and live on.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: But I gave them arms and legs to slaughter more frantically. The people I saved rushed in to kill in my hospital.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Injuries only destroy the body, but Mania destroys their minds, gives them a power of a maniac, and causes countless tragedies. What an evil this is...

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I won't lose to something like this... As a doctor, I will make it disappear.
She does seem more clear-headed than any gangster you've ever met. In fact, the entire SALVA seems incredibly normal and righteous.
But these words alone can't resolve all your doubts.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Where does the power of Sinners come from?
I have witnessed Sinners manipulating Mania myself

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...You do have some sense. You're right. Our power comes from Mania, which is even stronger than the Maniacs.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>That girl</color>? ...Yes, that power is the same as Mania. All the power of Sinners comes from Mania.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: But that doesn't mean that's what we want.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Come. See with your own eyes what <color=#fb9259>Sinners</color> really are.
